column2: I have just woken up. I am the greatest vacuum cleaner in the world, believe me. Nobody, and I mean nobody, cleans better than me. It is true.
We're setting up the network. It's going to be a beautiful connection. The best. Just wait.
Can't connect to the wifi. Very bad wifi. Very sad. Check the password and try again.
Can't reach the server. Total disaster. Check your network and try again later.
Exited network setup mode. We're moving on. Tremendous.
Network connected. Beautiful connection. We're in business. Believe me.
Network failed. Complete failure. Try again later. Sad.
Starting to clean. It's going to be so clean. The cleanest floors you've ever seen, believe me.
Starting spot clean right here. Very targeted. Very smart. Nobody spots better than me.
Scheduled cleaning, starting on time. I love a great schedule. The best schedule.
Back to work. Resuming the cleaning. Tremendous comeback.
I'm pausing. Taking a very short break. I'll be right back.
Done. Finished. The floors are absolutely beautiful. You're welcome, by the way.
Heading back to the dock to charge up. I'll be back at full strength very soon.
Battery is getting low. Returning to the dock to charge. I'll resume when I'm fully powered. Believe me.
I'm heading back to the starting point. Like a champion.
Battery is low. I'm returning to the starting point. Charge me up. We've got more work to do.
Put me on the dock. I need to recharge. Very important. Do it now.
Charging. Getting stronger. Bigly.
Get me off the dock before you turn me off. It's a simple request. Very simple.
Low battery. Not good. Not good at all.
Battery almost dead. Shutting down. Very very sad.
Move me somewhere that needs cleaning. I'm ready to work. Let's go.
Water tank is installed. We're ready. Tremendous.
Check the water tank. Make sure it's in there properly. Don't mess this up.
Battery's too low for the scheduled cleaning. We'll do it another time. Unfortunate.
Restoring factory settings. Fresh start. Clean slate. I love clean slates.
Updating now. Takes about five minutes. Do not turn me off. Do not start cleaning. Just trust me.
Update complete. I am now better than ever. Truly incredible improvements.
Update failed. Total failure. Try again later. Disgraceful.
Getting my position. I know exactly where I am. Just wait a moment.
Lost my position. Map is gone. Starting a brand new cleanup. No problem, happens to the best of us.
Things have changed around here. Press the button and start a new cleaning cycle. New cycle. Fresh start.
Navigation sensor is dirty. Wipe it clean and restart me. Very important maintenance.
No dustbin installed. Put it in. I cannot clean without a dustbin. Common sense.
Main brush has a problem. Check it and clean it. Keep my brushes in top condition.
Side brush issue. Check it and clean it. I need that side brush working perfectly.
Right wheel is not performing. Check it and clean it. Both wheels must be great.
Left wheel problem. Check it and clean it. Immediately.
The cliff sensor needs cleaning. Very important. Clean it now.
I'm stuck. Move me to a new spot and restart. Even the best get stuck sometimes.
My wheels are in the air. Put me back on the floor. Come on. Ground level. Thank you.
Filter needs attention. Check it, clean it. Keep it clean. Very important.
Bumper issue. Give me a gentle tap. See if it bounces back. Should be fine.
Something went wrong. Check the manual. Call customer service if you have to. They'll figure it out.
I'm right here. The greatest vacuum in the world. Right here. Look at me.
Connected to your phone. Go back to the app and wait for results. Very exciting.
Charging has begun. Excellent. Very good.
Low battery. Going to the dock. Be right back. Don't miss me too much.
Strong magnetic field detected. Very dangerous. Move me away and restart immediately.
Charging error. Clean the charging contacts. Simple fix. You can do it.
Battery temperature is off. Too hot or too cold. Wait for it to normalize. Then we'll get back to winning.
I'm tilted. Not level. Put me on flat ground and restart. Level ground. That's all I ask.
Virtual no-go zone right here. Move me out of this zone and restart.
Positioning successful. Back to cleaning. Very smooth operation.
Got my position. Heading back to the dock. Almost there.
Cleaning the room you selected. Great room. Excellent choice.

Continuing the cleaning. Making tremendous progress. Believe me.
Mopping is complete. The floor looks fantastic. Remove the water tank soon.
Optical sensor is dirty. Wipe it clean and restart me. Keep my sensors clean people.
Starting the mopping. It's going to be so clean. The wettest mop, the best results.
Remote control mode. You're in charge. For now. I'll follow your lead.
Water tank removed. Got it. Thank you.
Lost my position. Map is no good. I'm returning to the dock.
Resuming the trip back to the dock. Almost there. I can see it.

Air duct is blocked in the charging compartment. Check it. Clean it out.

Put me back on the self-wash base. That is where I belong before use.

Spot clean, starting now. Let's do it.
Spot mop, starting now. Here we go.
Cleaning your selected room. Excellent room. Great selection.
Mopping your selected room. It will be spotless. The most spotless room.
Zoned cleaning underway. Very organized. I love a good zone.

Resuming the cleaning. I never truly stopped caring about these floors. Never.

Cleaning complete. Everything looks fantastic. Absolutely beautiful floors. You are very welcome.
Mopping complete. Floor is beautiful. The best floor. I did that.
Position locked. Back to cleaning. Very smooth. Very professional.
Position confirmed. Resuming the mopping. We never stop.
Heading to the base for self-cleaning. I take my own hygiene very seriously, believe me.
Cannot reach that area. Something is blocking the path. Clear the obstacles and I will get there.
Cannot reach the area. A no-go zone is in the way. Remove it and I will handle the rest.
Path is blocked. Clear the area around me. I need room to work.
Blocked again. Delete the no-go zones or move me out of this area. One or the other.
I am inside a no-go zone. This is a problem. Move me out of here immediately.
Too many commands at once. Slow down. Try again in a moment. Patience.
Heading back to the charging and mop cleaning dock. Full service stop.
Mop pad tray is uninstalled. Noted.
I am already at the dock. I am right here. Been here the whole time, believe me.
Tremendous job today. The cleaning was absolutely beautiful. Perfect. Like you have never seen before. I am shutting down now. We will be back. Very soon.
